verses.text: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? Why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

segments.text: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
Why art thou so
far from helping me,
and from
the words of my groaning?

verses.text: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou answerest not; And in the night season, and am not silent.

segments.text: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou answerest not;
And in the night season, and am not silent.

verses.text: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

segments.text: But thou art holy,
O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

verses.text: Our fathers trusted in thee: They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

segments.text: Our fathers trusted in thee:
They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

verses.text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not put to shame.

segments.text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered:
They trusted in thee, and were not put to shame.

verses.text: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised of the people.

segments.text: But I am a worm, and no man;
A reproach of men, and despised of the people.

verses.text: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

segments.text: All they that see me laugh me to scorn:
They shoot out the lip, they shake the head,
saying

verses.text: Commit thyself unto Jehovah; let him deliver him: Let him rescue him, seeing he delighteth in him.

segments.text: Commit
thyself
unto Jehovah; let him deliver him:
Let him rescue him, seeing he delighteth in him.

verses.text: But thou art he that took me out of the womb; Thou didst make me trust when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

segments.text: But thou art he that took me out of the womb;
Thou didst make me trust
when I was
upon my mother’s breasts.

verses.text: I was cast upon thee from the womb; Thou art my God since my mother bare me.

segments.text: I was cast upon thee from the womb;
Thou art my God since my mother bare me.

verses.text: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; For there is none to help.

segments.text: Be not far from me; for trouble is near;
For there is none to help.

verses.text: Many bulls have compassed me; Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

segments.text: Many bulls have compassed me;
Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

verses.text: They gape upon me with their mouth, As a ravening and a roaring lion.

segments.text: They gape upon me with their mouth,
As
a ravening and a roaring lion.

verses.text: I am poured out like water, And all my bones are out of joint: My heart is like wax; It is melted within me.

segments.text: I am poured out like water,
And all my bones are out of joint:
My heart is like wax;
It is melted within me.

verses.text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

segments.text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd;
And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws;
And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

verses.text: For dogs have compassed me: A company of evil-doers have inclosed me; They pierced my hands and my feet.

segments.text: For dogs have compassed me:
A company of evil-doers have inclosed me;
They pierced my hands and my feet.

verses.text: I may count all my bones. They look and stare upon me;

segments.text: I may count all my bones.
They look and stare upon me;

verses.text: They part my garments among them, And upon my vesture do they cast lots.

segments.text: They part my garments among them,
And upon my vesture do they cast lots.

verses.text: But be not thou far off, O Jehovah: O thou my succor, haste thee to help me.

segments.text: But be not thou far off, O Jehovah:
O thou my succor, haste thee to help me.

verses.text: Deliver my soul from the sword, My darling from the power of the dog.

segments.text: Deliver my soul from the sword,
My darling from the power of the dog.

verses.text: Save me from the lion’s mouth; Yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen thou hast answered me.

segments.text: Save me from the lion’s mouth;
Yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen thou hast answered me.

verses.text: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: In the midst of the assembly will I praise thee.

segments.text: I will declare thy name unto my brethren:
In the midst of the assembly will I praise thee.

verses.text: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; And stand in awe of him, all ye the seed of Israel.

segments.text: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him;
All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him;
And stand in awe of him, all ye the seed of Israel.

verses.text: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Neither hath he hid his face from him; But when he cried unto him, he heard.

segments.text: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted;
Neither hath he hid his face from him;
But when he cried unto him, he heard.

verses.text: Of thee cometh my praise in the great assembly: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

segments.text: Of thee cometh my praise in the great assembly:
I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

verses.text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; They shall praise Jehovah that seek after him: Let your heart live for ever.

segments.text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied;
They shall praise Jehovah that seek after him:
Let your heart live for ever.

verses.text: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah; And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

segments.text: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah;
And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

verses.text: For the kingdom is Jehovah’s; And he is the ruler over the nations.

segments.text: For the kingdom is Jehovah’s;
And he is the ruler over the nations.

verses.text: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship: All they that go down to the dust shall bow before him, Even he that cannot keep his soul alive.

segments.text: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship:
All they that go down to the dust shall bow before him,
Even he that cannot keep his soul alive.

verses.text: A seed shall serve him; It shall be told of the Lord unto the next generation.

segments.text: A seed shall serve him;
It shall be told of the Lord unto the
next
generation.

verses.text: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it.

segments.text: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness
Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Aijeleth hash-Shahar. A Psalm of David.
